description: Standing on the Onyar riverfront at night, you take in Girona's famous painted houses glowing along the riverbank, with the cathedral's great mass rising behind them to the right. The lit façades reflect in the dark water, and the frame centers on the old town's postcard view at its most theatrical hour. After midnight the riverside is hushed, the city asleep behind its lights.

prompts.prompt-r2.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the Cathedral of Santa Maria of Girona, Catalonia, Spain, at DEEP ASTRONOMICAL NIGHT (around 5:30 in the morning). Tourist viewpoint: the river bank opposite, looking across at the cathedral — the great broad UNSPIRED Baroque facade of Girona's cathedral, its SINGLE bell tower with cupola, and the sweeping baroque staircase below; the old town's colourful river houses. CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE RULE: the cathedral must have NO spires, NO tall Gothic pinnacles, NO rose-window tower anywhere — a wide flat-facade church with one cupola-topped tower only. Deep night: pitch-dark star-filled sky, moonlight, faint warm window light. NO daylight, NO dawn glow, NO blue-hour brightness. Main subject centered. No identifiable people. Absolutely no legible text, lettering, numbers, signs or plaques anywhere in the image.
